text:
Sam (Eng): Who's up for a quick after-work thing this Thu? thinking board games + microbrew tasting at the office terrace — 6pm? :game_die: :beers: 
Priya (Product): yes pls! can we do vegetarian snacks? :raised_hands: 
Noah (Design): I'm in. 6pm works. can we keep games to ~45–60min rounds so folks can bounce if needed.
Lily (People Ops): We can reserve the terrace and order from Greenwich Eats. Quick poll — react with :one: for 5:30, :two: for 6:00, :three: for 6:30. Snacks: react :pretzel: savory, :cake: sweet, :leafy_green: veg-friendly.
Kevin (Eng-SRE): I'll bring Catan and a small Bluetooth speaker. Also happy to haul boxes.
Sam (Eng): awesome. @Noah shorter games noted. anyone free to help set up at 5:30? need 1-2 volunteers to grab tables/chairs.
Priya (Product): I can help with setup — and I'll coordinate the snack order with Lily.
EventBot: Reminder: Office terrace reserved Thu 5:15–8:00 by People Ops.
Lily (People Ops): thanks @Priya! looks like :two: (6:00) is winning so we'll lock that. I'll place the order for veg-forward snacks + a small beer selection.
Marcus (Data): might be a bit late (dinner w/ family) — put me as maybe.
Sam (Eng): :thumbsup: Final plan: Board games + microbrew tasting • Thursday • 6:00pm • Terrace. RSVP in-thread: ✅ coming, 🙋 helping setup, ❓maybe. I'll post a quick checklist tomorrow.
Priya (Product): small ask — can we take a casual photo for socials? totally optional.
Lily (People Ops): :camera_with_flash: we'll only post people who opt in. DM me to opt-out. Current RSVP: Sam, Priya (setup), Noah, Kevin, Marcus (maybe). More folks welcome!
